guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice has by far the largest anomaly (latency-90 z=+931, p90 0.094s to 4.47s) and its socket count rose from 3 to 24.5 (+715%), while memory rose less (+152%), so the socket signal is the more specific one. Frontend and checkout latency and the frontend errors look downstream of it, and the workload drops fit failing requests; the worst traces do not show currencyservice spans, which is why confidence is only medium.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the currencyservice pods to clear the leaked or exhausted sockets, then inspect connection handling and limits in currencyservice and its callers (frontend, checkout).
